text: you're not the only one awake.
counted sheep, counted regrets instead.
3am knows all my secrets.
the ceiling has heard a lot from me this week.
morning always comes anyway.
the second month is harder than the first. it gets easier after.
my favorite coffee shop doesn't know my order yet.
walked 40 blocks today just to feel something familiar.
home is a thing you build, not a place you find.
the grocery store felt like an adventure today. small wins.
screamed into a pillow. in the best way.
carrying good news is its own kind of heavy.
told my dog. she was supportive.
this is gonna change everything and nobody knows yet.
i don't miss them. i miss who i was with them.
the playlist sounds different now.
deleted the photos. kept the lessons.
clarity hits different at 1am.
monday hasn't even started and i'm already tired.
sunday evenings are emotional speed bumps.
made a to-do list to feel in control. did not feel in control.
the dread is always worse than the thing.
nobody clapped. didn't need them to.
did the thing i've been avoiding for three weeks.
small victory. huge feeling.
past me would be impressed.
drafted the text. deleted it. again.
some people are only yours in memories.
saw their favorite song on a playlist. skipped it. played it again.
grief is just love with nowhere to go.
burned the map. building a new one.
nervous and excited are the same feeling.
day one, attempt number who-knows. this time feels different.
the blank page is terrifying and beautiful.
